Consiste in unità a Konolfingen (CH), Marysville (USA), Orbe (CH) e Singapore e fornisce nuovi prodotti e processi a tutti i mercati Nestlé in tutto il mondo.

La nostra missione è di deliziare il consumatore ovunque, ma offrendo momenti di autentico piacere e indulgenza, ci spinge ad attrarre, selezionare e sviluppare le persone giuste per i posti di lavoro giusti lungo tutta la catena del valore della nostra attività.

Istantanea posizione

- Località: Orbe, Svizzera - Azienda: Nestlé Product Technology Centre Caffè - Atto. Tariffa: Full-Time Act. Prezzo 100% - Tipo di contratto: Contratto permanente

Sintesi della posizione

Come azienda specializzata in R&D di Associate Packaging - Caratterizzazione dei materiali, sarà responsabile del supporto dei responsabili di progetto di imballaggio nel settore dei sistemi di caffè, nella caratterizzazione dei materiali.proprietà meccaniche, termiche e di gas. per definire le interazioni tra capsule, cialde e macchine da caffè. Svilupperete e adatterete strumenti avanzati con una forte attenzione alla digitalizzazione per accelerare i processi di sviluppo. In questo ruolo, costruirete competenze in materiali a base di carta, alluminio e plastica.

Un giorno nella vita di un imballaggio specializzato di R&S di assortimento - caratterizzazione del materiale

- Sfruttare i metodi di caratterizzazione dei materiali per definire le proprietà e le specifiche dei pacchetti per capsule e capsule - Proporre concetti innovativi di materiali, progettazione e caratterizzazione con il team di metodi NPTC - Costruire, documentare e condividere le conoscenze dei materiali attraverso i team di packaging - Sostenere la trasformazione digitale dei processi di caratterizzazione per accelerare lo sviluppo - Definire la progettazione degli esperimenti per soddisfare i risultati del progetto - Supportare i Project Manager e fornire risultati allineati con le linee temporali dei progetti - Presentare metodi e risultati chiaramente agli stakeholder e ai visitatori - Supporto interno e

reti esterne per proteggere IP, trasferire conoscenze e applicare le norme SHE

Cosa ti farà avere successo

- Laurea magistrale in Scienze dei Materiali o Ingegneria Meccanica - Esperienza professionale in ambiente R&D - Proficienza in CAD 3D e strumenti di analisi degli elementi finiti - Conoscenza delle proprietà meccaniche e termiche - Digitalmente savvy, compresa la padronanza degli strumenti AI e la capacità di programmare in Python - Mindset di forte innovazione - Ottima soluzione dei problemi e approccio orientato alla soluzione - Buona padronanza dell'inglese (parlato e scritto)

A Nestlé vogliamo contribuire a creare un mondo migliore e più sano, ispirare le persone a vivere una vita più sana e a dare un impatto su una scala e un ritmo che facciano la differenza. Lo facciamo promuovendo un ambiente diversificato, amichevole, solidale e collaborativo, che crei un'innovazione positiva, che permetta alle persone e alle squadre di vincere. Ci proponiamo di assumere persone cordiali, rispettose, che ispirino alle persone che si preoccupano delle vite che tocchiamo ogni singolo giorno.

Siate una forza per il bene. Unisciti a Nestlé e visitaci su www.nestle.com.

Positions-Aufzeichnung

- Ort: Orbe, Schweiz - Firma: Nestlé Product Technology Centre Coffee - Act. Rate: Full-Time Act. Rate 100% - Art des Vertrags: Permanenter Vertrag

Zusammenfassung der Position

Als Associate R&D Specialist Packaging - Materialcharakterisierung unterstützen Sie die Projektmanager von Packaging im Bereich Kaffeesysteme bei der Charakterisierung von Materialien – mechanische, thermische und Gas-Barriere-Eigenschaften – zur Definition von Wechselwirkungen zwischen Kapseln, Pods und Kaffeemaschinen. Sie entwickeln und passen fortschrittliche Werkzeuge mit einem starken Fokus auf Digitalisierung an, um Entwicklungsprozesse zu beschleunigen. In dieser Funktion bauen Sie Expertise in papierbasierten Materialien, Aluminium und Kunststoffen auf.

Ein Tag im Leben eines assoziierten FuE-Spezialisten Verpackung - Materialcharakterisierung

- Leverage Materialcharakterisierungsmethoden zur Definition von Verpackungseigenschaften und Spezifikationen für Kapseln und Hülsen - Vorschläge für innovative Material-, Design- und Charakterisierungskonzepte mit dem NPTC-Methodenteam - Aufbau, Dokumentation und Austausch von Materialwissen über Verpackungsteams hinweg - Unterstützung der digitalen Transformation von Charakterisierungsprozessen zur Beschleunigung der Entwicklung - Definieren Sie Design of Experiments zur Begegnung mit Projektlieferanten - Unterstützung von Projektmanagern und liefern Sie Ergebnisse, die auf Projektzeiten abgestimmt sind - Präsentieren Sie Methoden und Ergebnisse klar für Stakeholder und Besucher - Unterstützung von internen und

externe Netzwerke zur Sicherung von IP, Wissenstransfer und Anwendung der SHE-Regeln

Was macht Sie erfolgreich

- Master in Materialwissenschaft oder Maschinenbau - Bewährte Erfahrung in einer FuE-Umgebung - Kenntnisse in 3D CAD und Finite Element Analysis Tools - Starkes Verständnis der mechanischen und thermischen Materialeigenschaften - Digital savvy, einschließlich der Beherrschung von KI-Tools und der Fähigkeit, in Python zu programmieren - Starke Innovationseinstellung - Ausgezeichnete Problemlösung und Lösungsorientierter Ansatz - Gute Englischkenntnisse (ausgesprochen und schriftlich)

En tant que spécialiste associé de la R-D Emballage - Caractérisation des matériaux, vous serez responsable de l'appui aux gestionnaires de projets d'emballage dans le domaine des systèmes de café, de la caractérisation des matériaux – propriétés mécaniques, thermiques et des barres de gaz – pour définir les interactions entre les capsules, les gousses et les machines à café.

jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: On-site / Full-time 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and build technology that matters.

As a Smart Sensors Specialist at the Deep Tech Center, your mission is to explore and develop new sensor technologies for process control, production quality, and breakthrough consumer experiences. Across our hubs in Switzerland and China, we advance manufacturing, consumer experiences and research by leveraging robotics, sensors, AI, machine learning and digital twins. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams across research and development, businesses, markets, factories, and external partners. This is your opportunity to accelerate Nestlé’s innovation mission through cutting edge technologies and shape the future of food at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Smart Sensors Specialist

• Leading the development of innovative sensor solutions that improve process control, product quality, and consumer experience.

• Driving test bench, pilot, and proof-of-concept activities that turn scientific ideas into scalable, real-world applications.

• Building robust data acquisition and connectivity approaches that enable reliable measurement and smarter decision-making.

• Delivering technical support to projects and stakeholders with solutions that are effective, sustainable, and fit for purpose.

• Advancing digitalization by generating high-quality datasets and applying sensor expertise to modelling and automation initiatives.

• Sharing knowledge through documentation, publications, and mentoring that strengthen capabilities across teams and projects.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in sensor development, measurement science, and hands-on experimental work to create practical, high-impact solutions.

• Applying knowledge of statistics, variability analysis, and metrology to assess performance, improve reliability, and support robust decision-making.

• Using programming and data analysis skills with a high level of autonomy to advance connected systems, automation, and digital innovation.

• Collaborating as a strong team player across disciplines, with PhD research or operations experience considered a strong plus.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Thriving in a highly collaborative, innovation-driven environment, and being ready to move fast from concept to reality.

At Nestlé Deep Tech Center, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• State-of-the-art facility with creative spaces, rapid prototyping labs, automated kitchens, and pilot plants.

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentia

Notre département Engineering s’assure 7/7j et 24/24h de la disponibilité de nos installations du point de vue technique par des actions préventives, correctives, et maintenance et d’amélioration. En tant que Technicien.ne de maintenance en horaire 5x8, vous êtes responsable de la surveillance et de la maintenance de nos installations complexes de fabrication de café soluble, dans le strict respect des règles de sécurité et d'hygiène.

jobs.description:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: On-site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent
Target start date: As soon as possible

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead at Nestlé Research, your mission is to ensure Nestlé Research has access to the best science globally. By leading research alliances, science insourcing, and scientific intelligence, you will strengthen access to external expertise, scientific knowledge, literature, and innovation ecosystems that complement and amplify Nestlé Research’s scientific capabilities. Working closely with research leaders, science and technology teams, legal and contract partners, universities, research institutes, startups, scientific publishers, associations, and external experts, you will help transform ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead

• Leading the research alliances and science insourcing strategy to build high-value partnerships with academia, startups, publishers, scientific and innovation ecosystems.

• Driving strategic collaborations that accelerate discovery, strengthen innovation impact, and support Nestlé Research priorities.

• Creating seamless access to internal and external scientific knowledge by connecting researchers to experts, scientific literature, publishers, information sources, and research services that expand Nestlé Research capabilities.

• Transforming scientific intelligence into a strategic capability by identifying, connecting, and translating emerging scientific trends, publications, and external expertise into actionable insights for research and innovation.

• Strengthening Nestlé Research’s scientific reputation by building trusted relationships with universities, talent pools, and external thought leaders.

• Developing an engaged, inclusive, and future-ready team that builds capabilities, fosters collaboration, and delivers shared priorities.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD or equivalent scientific background, combined with the credibility and curiosity to connect cutting-edge science with business needs, innovation opportunities, and long-term value creation.

• Applying 10+ years of experience in R&D, scientific innovation, external collaborations, or related scientific leadership to shape strategy, influence stakeholders, and deliver measurable impact.

• Leveraging strong experience across Nestlé Research, Nestlé Product Technology Centers, and the broader R&D organization to foster connections between capabilities, partnerships, expertise, and scientific services, ensuring alignment with business and innovation priorities.

• Demonstrating success in academic partnerships, innovation ecosystems, with a proven ability to create trusted relationships and deliver measurable impact.

• Proven experience in leading complex initiatives in a direct or indirect leadership role.

• Bringing experience in the management, development, or strategic utilization of scientific infrastructures, research services, knowledge platforms, or shared capabilities.

• Demonstrating strong strategic communication and influencing skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific topics into compelling narratives, build alignment, and engage diverse internal and external stakeholders.

• Bringing collaboration, intellectual curiosity, fresh thinking, constructive challenge, respect, and a positive mindset.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically include

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: On-site / Tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente
Data di inizio destinazione: appena possibile

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

In qualità di Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead at Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è garantire che Nestlé Research abbia accesso alla migliore scienza a livello globale. Con le principali alleanze di ricerca, insourcing scientifico e intelligenza scientifica, rafforzerete l’accesso a competenze esterne, conoscenze scientifiche, letteratura e ecosistemi di innovazione che completano e amplificano le capacità scientifiche di Nestlé Research. Lavorando a stretto contatto con leader di ricerca, team di scienza e tecnologia, partner legali e contrattuali, università, istituti di ricerca, startup, editori scientifici, associazioni ed esperti esterni, vi aiuterà a trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come Ricerca alleanze & Scienza Insourcing Lead

• Guidare le alleanze di ricerca e la strategia di insourcing della scienza per costruire partnership di alto valore con accademia, startup, editori, ecosistemi scientifici e innovativi.

• Guidare collaborazioni strategiche che accelerano la scoperta, rafforzare l'impatto dell'innovazione e sostenere le priorità di Nestlé Research.

• Creare un accesso senza soluzione di continuità alle conoscenze scientifiche interne ed esterne collegando ricercatori a esperti, letteratura scientifica, editori, fonti di informazione e servizi di ricerca che espandono le capacità di Nestlé Research.

• Trasformare l'intelligenza scientifica in una capacità strategica identificando, collegando e traducendo tendenze scientifiche emergenti, pubblicazioni e competenze esterne in insight attuabili per la ricerca e l'innovazione.

• Rafforzare la reputazione scientifica di Nestlé Research costruendo relazioni di fiducia con università, pool di talenti e leader di pensiero esterni.

• Sviluppare un team impegnato, inclusivo e pronto per il futuro che costruisce capacità, promuove la collaborazione e offre priorità condivise.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare un dottorato o un background scientifico equivalente, combinato con la credibilità e la curiosità di collegare la scienza all'avanguardia con le esigenze aziendali, le opportunità di innovazione e la creazione di valore a lungo termine.

• Applicando 10+ anni di esperienza in R&D, innovazione scientifica, collaborazioni esterne, o relativa leadership scientifica per modellare la strategia, influenzare le parti interessate e fornire un impatto misurabile.

• Sfruttando una forte esperienza tra Nestlé Research, Nestlé Product Technology Centers e la più ampia organizzazione R&D per promuovere connessioni tra capacità, partnership, competenze e servizi scientifici, garantendo l'allineamento con le priorità di business e innovazione.

• Dimostrando il successo in partnership accademiche, ecosistemi di innovazione, con una comprovata capacità di creare relazioni affidabili e fornire un impatto misurabile.

• Esperienza dimostrata nelle principali iniziative complesse in un ruolo di leadership diretto o indiretto.

• Portare esperienza nella gestione, sviluppo, o utilizzo strategico di infrastrutture scientifiche, servizi di ricerca, piattaforme di conoscenza, o capacità condivise.

• Dimostrare una forte comunicazione strategica e influenzare le competenze, con la capacità di tradurre argomenti scientifici complessi in narrazioni convincenti, costruire allineamento, e coinvolgere diversi stakeholder interni ed esterni.

• Portare la collaborazione, la curiosità intellettuale, il pensiero fresco, la sfida costruttiva, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati a un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione in genere include

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

Als Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead bei Nestlé Research möchten Sie sicherstellen, dass Nestlé Research Zugang zu den besten Wissenschaften weltweit hat. Durch die Leitung von Forschungsallianzen, Science Insourcing und Scientific Intelligence stärken Sie den Zugang zu externem Fachwissen, wissenschaftlichem Wissen, Literatur und Innovationsökosystemen, die die wissenschaftlichen Fähigkeiten von Nestlé Research ergänzen und erweitern. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Forschungsleitern, Wissenschafts- und Technologieteams, Rechts- und Vertragspartnern, Universitäten, Forschungsinstituten, Start-ups, wissenschaftlichen Verlagen, Verbänden und externen Experten helfen Sie dabei, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead Einfluss nehmen können

• Führen der Forschungsallianzen und der Science-Insourcing-Strategie zum Aufbau hochwertiger Partnerschaften mit Hochschulen, Startups, Verlagen, wissenschaftlichen und Innovationsökosystemen.

• Förderung strategischer Kooperationen, die die Entdeckung beschleunigen, die Innovationswirkung stärken und die Prioritäten von Nestlé Research unterstützen.

• Schaffung eines nahtlosen Zugangs zu internen und externen wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnissen durch die Verbindung von Forschern mit Experten, wissenschaftlicher Literatur, Verlagen, Informationsquellen und Forschungsdiensten, die Nestlé Research Fähigkeiten erweitern.

• Die Transformation wissenschaftlicher Intelligenz in eine strategische Fähigkeit durch die Identifizierung, Verknüpfung und Übersetzung von aufkommenden wissenschaftlichen Trends, Publikationen und externem Fachwissen in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse für Forschung und Innovation.

• Stärkung des wissenschaftlichen Rufs von Nestlé Research durch den Aufbau vertrauenswürdiger Beziehungen zu Universitäten, Talentpools und externen Vordenkern.

• Entwicklung eines engagierten, integrativen und zukunftsfähigen Teams, das Fähigkeiten aufbaut, die Zusammenarbeit fördert und gemeinsame Prioritäten setzt.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Bringen Sie einen PhD oder einen gleichwertigen wissenschaftlichen Hintergrund mit, kombiniert mit der Glaubwürdigkeit und Neugier, Spitzenwissenschaft mit Geschäftsanforderungen, Innovationsmöglichkeiten und langfristiger Wertschöpfung zu verbinden.

• Anwendung von mehr als 10 Jahren Erfahrung in Forschung und Entwicklung, wissenschaftlicher Innovation, externer Zusammenarbeit oder verwandter wissenschaftlicher Führung, um Strategien zu gestalten, Interessengruppen zu beeinflussen und messbare Auswirkungen zu erzielen.

• Nutzung starker Erfahrung in Nestlé Research, Nestlé Product Technology Centern und der breiteren F & E-Organisation, um Verbindungen zwischen Fähigkeiten, Partnerschaften, Fachwissen und wissenschaftlichen Dienstleistungen zu fördern und die Ausrichtung auf Geschäfts- und Innovationsprioritäten sicherzustellen.

• Nachweis des Erfolgs in akademischen Partnerschaften, Innovationsökosystemen, mit der nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, vertrauenswürdige Beziehungen aufzubauen und messbare Auswirkungen zu erzielen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Initiativen in einer direkten oder indirekten Führungsrolle.

• Mitbringen von Erfahrung in der Verwaltung, Entwicklung oder strategischen Nutzung von wissenschaftlichen Infrastrukturen, Forschungsdienstleistungen, Wissensplattformen oder gemeinsamen Fähigkeiten.

• Demonstrieren starker strategischer Kommunikation und beeinflussender Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe wissenschaftliche Themen in überzeugende Narrative zu übersetzen, Ausrichtung aufzubauen und verschiedene interne und externe Interessengruppen einzubeziehen.

• Bringt Zusammenarbeit, intellektuelle Neugier, frisches Denken, konstruktive Herausforderung, Respekt und eine positive Denkweise.

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

En tant que responsable des alliances de recherche et de l'approvisionnement scientifique chez Nestlé Research, votre mission est de vous assurer que Nestlé Research a accès aux meilleures sciences du monde. En dirigeant des alliances de recherche, des ressources scientifiques et de l'intelligence scientifique, vous renforcerez l'accès à l'expertise externe, aux connaissances scientifiques, à la littérature et aux écosystèmes d'innovation qui complètent et amplifient les capacités scientifiques de Nestlé Research. Travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des responsables de la recherche, des équipes scientifiques et technologiques, des partenaires juridiques et contractuels, des universités, des instituts de recherche, des startups, des éditeurs scientifiques, des associations et des experts externes, vous aiderez à transformer des idées en solutions durables et innovantes pour les personnes, les animaux domestiques et la planète.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead

• Diriger les alliances de recherche et la stratégie d'approvisionnement scientifique pour établir des partenariats de grande valeur avec les universités, les startups, les éditeurs, les écosystèmes scientifiques et d'innovation.

• Diriger des collaborations stratégiques qui accélèrent la découverte, renforcent l'impact de l'innovation et soutiennent les priorités de Nestlé Research.

• Créer un accès transparent aux connaissances scientifiques internes et externes en reliant les chercheurs aux experts, à la littérature scientifique, aux éditeurs, aux sources d'information et aux services de recherche qui élargissent les capacités de recherche de Nestlé.

• Transformer l'intelligence scientifique en une capacité stratégique en identifiant, en reliant et en transformant les nouvelles tendances scientifiques, les publications et l'expertise externe en idées pratiques pour la recherche et l'innovation.

• Renforcer la réputation scientifique de Nestlé en établissant des relations de confiance avec les universités, les bassins de talents et les leaders de la pensée externe.

• Développer une équipe engagée, inclusive et prête à l'avenir qui renforce les capacités, favorise la collaboration et réalise des priorités communes.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter un doctorat ou un bagage scientifique équivalent, combiné avec la crédibilité et la curiosité de relier la science de pointe aux besoins des entreprises, aux possibilités d'innovation et à la création de valeur à long terme.

• Appliquer plus de 10 ans d'expérience en R-D, en innovation scientifique, en collaboration externe ou en leadership scientifique connexe pour façonner la stratégie, influencer les intervenants et produire des résultats mesurables.

• Tirer parti d'une solide expérience dans les centres de recherche Nestlé, les centres de technologie des produits Nestlé et l'organisation plus vaste de R-D pour favoriser les liens entre les capacités, les partenariats, l'expertise et les services scientifiques, en assurant l'harmonisation avec les priorités des entreprises et de l'innovation.

• Démontrer le succès dans les partenariats universitaires, les écosystèmes d'innovation, avec une capacité avérée de créer des relations de confiance et d'obtenir un impact mesurable.

• Expérience éprouvée dans la conduite d'initiatives complexes dans un rôle de leadership direct ou indirect.

• Apporter de l'expérience dans la gestion, le développement ou l'utilisation stratégique des infrastructures scientifiques, des services de recherche, des plateformes de connaissances ou des capacités partagées.

• Démontrer une communication stratégique solide et influencer les compétences, avec la capacité de traduire des sujets scientifiques complexes en récits convaincants, construire l'alignement, et mobiliser divers intervenants internes et externes.

• Apporter collaboration, curiosité intellectuelle, pensée fraîche, défi constructif, respect, et un état d'esprit positif.

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend généralement :

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based / Full time
Contract type / duration: Fixed-term contract (2 years)

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (Fermentation & DSP) at Nestlé Research, your mission is to lead bioprocessing activities that bridge lab-scale discovery and industrial manufacturing through robust fermentation and downstream processing solutions. jobs.description:
Strategic Research Operations

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Lab Data Technology Specialist at Nestlé Research within our Computational Sciences department, you will be responsible for reinforcing our laboratory data foundations to help unlock the full value of the data generated by our scientific instruments and laboratory systems. Sitting at the intersection of science, laboratory data, and modern data engineering, you will leverage latest data technologies and AI for coding tools to transform raw, heterogeneous scientific data into trusted, well-documented, and reusable data assets that accelerate impactful scientific research.

How you’ll make an impact as a Lab Data Technology Specialist

• Partner with laboratory stakeholders. data domain owners, lab business analysts together with data architects and engineers to translate functional requirements into scalable, and well-documented technical solutions, ensuring alignment between scientific workflows and technological capabilities

• Enable new and existing laboratory instruments end to end, from understanding the scientific workflow and data outputs to defining and establishing connectivity and data flow (LIMS, robotics, automation platforms, downstream systems), in collaboration with IT network, security specialists

• Collaborate with internal and external professionals to propose and implement customizations to lab digital platforms used (LIMS, instrument integration, technology specific data processing, metadata capture) in view of efficiency, quality, traceability, and governance by design

• Identify opportunities to increase value of lab data gathered across different sources by leveraging data technologies (data integrations, data warehousing, automated data quality checks, etc)

• Support testing, deployment, change management, and continuous improvement of compliant, scalable lab solutions, including AI-enabled opportunities to strengthen data flows and unlock value from lab data

What will make you successful

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific or computational discipline (e.g., Chemistry, life sciences, Bioinformatics, Cheminformatics, Data Engineering, Computer Science), or equivalent experience.

• Solid experience in applying data engineering to scientific, laboratory data

• Required technical skills

•

• LIMS customization, data models, and integration.

• Integrating lab instruments, applications, robots, and IoT with reference databases and data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake).

• Solid grasp of the lab solutions ecosystem: ELN, CDS, LES, multi-omics pipelines, IoT-connected equipment, barcode systems, etc.

• Programming (e.g., Python, R, Java, Groovy).

• Data engineering and modeling — ETL/ELT (Airflow, dbt), APIs, orchestration, SQL/NoSQL — with engineering rigor (Git, CI/CD, testing, data quality, observability, reproducibility).

• Nice-to-have technical skills

• Semantic modeling, ontologies, and knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/SPARQL, biomedical/chemical vocabularies).

• FAIR data implementation, metadata management, and lineage tooling

• Enabling AI/ML and analytics use cases on scientific data

• Domain exposure in chemistry, biology, food, or omics

• Reporting tools (e.g., DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) is an advantage

• Leveraging Agentic AI to automate data engineering activities

• Required non-technical skills

• Strong problem-solving and hands-on mindset

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Experience collaborating with external vendors and data professionals and driving delivery through others

• Ability to work in cross-functional and international teams

• Strong organizational and prioritization skills

• Fluent spoken and written Eng

Sitting at the intersection of science, laboratory data, and modern data engineering, you will leverage latest data technologies and AI for coding tools to transform raw, heterogeneous scientific data into trusted, well-documented, and reusable data assets that accelerate impactful scientific research.

How you’ll make an impact as a Lab Data Technology Specialist

• Partner with laboratory stakeholders. data domain owners, lab business analysts together with data architects and engineers to translate functional requirements into scalable, and well-documented technical solutions, ensuring alignment between scientific workflows and technological capabilities

• Enable new and existing laboratory instruments end to end, from understanding the scientific workflow and data outputs to defining and establishing connectivity and data flow (LIMS, robotics, automation platforms, downstream systems), in collaboration with IT network, security specialists

• Collaborate with internal and external professionals to propose and implement customizations to lab digital platforms used (LIMS, instrument integration, technology specific data processing, metadata capture) in view of efficiency, quality, traceability, and governance by design

• Identify opportunities to increase value of lab data gathered across different sources by leveraging data technologies (data integrations, data warehousing, automated data quality checks, etc)

• Support testing, deployment, change management, and continuous improvement of compliant, scalable lab solutions, including AI-enabled opportunities to strengthen data flows and unlock value from lab data

What will make you successful

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific or computational discipline (e.g., Chemistry, life sciences, Bioinformatics, Cheminformatics, Data Engineering, Computer Science), or equivalent experience.

• Solid experience in applying data engineering to scientific, laboratory data

• Required technical skills

•

• LIMS customization, data models, and integration.

• Integrating lab instruments, applications, robots, and IoT with reference databases and data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake).

• Solid grasp of the lab solutions ecosystem: ELN, CDS, LES, multi-omics pipelines, IoT-connected equipment, barcode systems, etc.

• Programming (e.g., Python, R, Java, Groovy).

• Data engineering and modeling — ETL/ELT (Airflow, dbt), APIs, orchestration, SQL/NoSQL — with engineering rigor (Git, CI/CD, testing, data quality, observability, reproducibility).

• Nice-to-have technical skills

• Semantic modeling, ontologies, and knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/SPARQL, biomedical/chemical vocabularies).

• FAIR data implementation, metadata management, and lineage tooling

• Enabling AI/ML and analytics use cases on scientific data

• Domain exposure in chemistry, biology, food, or omics

• Reporting tools (e.g., DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) is an advantage

• Leveraging Agentic AI to automate data engineering activities

• Required non-technical skills

• Strong problem-solving and hands-on mindset

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Experience collaborating with external vendors and data professionals and driving delivery through others

• Ability to work in cross-functional and international teams

• Strong organizational and prioritization skills

• Fluent spoken and written Eng

Vertragsart/Dauer: Permanent

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

Als Lab Data Technology Specialist bei Nestlé Research in unserer Computational Sciences-Abteilung sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, unsere Labordatengrundlagen zu stärken, um den vollen Wert der von unseren wissenschaftlichen Instrumenten und Laborsystemen generierten Daten zu erschließen. An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft, Labordaten und moderner Datentechnik werden Sie die neuesten Datentechnologien und KI für Codierungswerkzeuge nutzen, um rohe, heterogene wissenschaftliche Daten in vertrauenswürdige, gut dokumentierte und wiederverwendbare Datenressourcen umzuwandeln, die eine wirkungsvolle wissenschaftliche Forschung beschleunigen.

Wie Sie als Lab Data Technology Specialist etwas bewirken können

• Zusammenarbeit mit Laborbeteiligten. Datendomänenbesitzer, Labor-Business-Analysten zusammen mit Datenarchitekten und Ingenieuren, um funktionale Anforderungen in skalierbare und gut dokumentierte technische Lösungen zu übersetzen und so eine Abstimmung zwischen wissenschaftlichen Workflows und technologischen Fähigkeiten zu gewährleisten

• Ermöglichen Sie neue und bestehende Laborinstrumente durchgängig, vom Verständnis des wissenschaftlichen Workflows und der Datenausgaben bis hin zur Definition und Etablierung von Konnektivität und Datenfluss (LIMS, Robotik, Automatisierungsplattformen, nachgelagerte Systeme) in Zusammenarbeit mit IT-Netzwerken und Sicherheitsexperten.

• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten, den Wert von Labordaten aus verschiedenen Quellen zu erhöhen, indem Sie Datentechnologien nutzen (Datenintegrationen, Data Warehousing, automatisierte Datenqualitätsprüfungen usw.)

• Unterstützung von Testing, Deployment, Change Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung konformer, skalierbarer Laborlösungen, einschließlich KI-fähiger Möglichkeiten zur Stärkung des Datenflusses und zur Wertschöpfung aus Labordaten

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Opérations stratégiques de recherche

Lieu: Lausanne, Suisse
Modèle de travail: Hybride / Temps plein 100%
Type de contrat / durée: Permanent

Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

En tant que spécialiste de la technologie des données de laboratoire chez Nestlé Research au sein de notre département des Sciences Computationnelles, vous serez responsable du renforcement de nos bases de données de laboratoire pour aider à débloquer toute la valeur des données générées par nos instruments scientifiques et nos systèmes de laboratoire. Assis à l'intersection de la science, des données de laboratoire et de l'ingénierie moderne des données, vous tirerez parti des dernières technologies de données et de l'IA pour coder des outils pour transformer les données scientifiques brutes et hétérogènes en données fiables, bien documentées et réutilisables qui accélèrent la recherche scientifique impactée.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que spécialiste de la technologie des données de laboratoire

• Partenaire avec les intervenants du laboratoire. les propriétaires de domaines de données, les analystes commerciaux de laboratoire ainsi que les architectes et ingénieurs de données pour traduire les exigences fonctionnelles en solutions techniques évolutives et bien documentées, assurant l'alignement entre les flux de travail scientifiques et les capacités technologiques

• Permettre aux nouveaux et existants instruments de laboratoire de se terminer, de la compréhension du flux de travail scientifique et des sorties de données à la définition et l'établissement de la connectivité et du flux de données (LIMS, robotique, plateformes d'automatisation, systèmes en aval), en collaboration avec le réseau informatique, les spécialistes de la sécurité

• Collaborer avec des professionnels internes et externes pour proposer et mettre en œuvre des personnalisations aux plateformes numériques de laboratoire utilisées (LIMS, intégration d'instruments, traitement de données spécifiques à la technologie, capture de métadonnées) en vue de l'efficacité, de la qualité, de la traçabilité et de la gouvernance par la conception

• Identifier les possibilités d'accroître la valeur des données de laboratoire recueillies entre différentes sources en tirant parti des technologies de données (intégration des données, entreposage des données, contrôle automatisé de la qualité des données, etc.)

• Soutenir les essais, le déploiement, la gestion du changement et l'amélioration continue des solutions de laboratoire conformes et évolutives, y compris les possibilités permettant de renforcer les flux de données et de débloquer la valeur des données de laboratoire

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences ou en informatique (p. ex. chimie, sciences de la vie, bioinformatique, chimie, génie des données, informatique) ou expérience équivalente.

• Une solide expérience dans l'application de l'ingénierie des données aux données scientifiques et de laboratoire

• Compétences techniques requises

•

• Personnalisation LIMS, modèles de données et intégration.

• Intégrer les instruments de laboratoire, les applications, les robots et l'IdO avec les bases de données de référence et les entrepôts de données (p. ex., Snowflake).

• Une bonne compréhension de l'écosystème des solutions de laboratoire : ELN, CDS, ERP, pipelines multi-omiques, équipements connectés à l'IoT, systèmes de codes à barres, etc.

• Programmation (p. ex. Python, R, Java, Groovy).

• Ingénierie et modélisation des données — ETL/ELT (Airflow, dbt), API, orchestration, SQL/NoSQL — avec rigueur technique (Git, CI/CD, test, qualité des données, observabilité, reproductibilité).

• Bonnes compétences techniques

• Modélisation sémantique, ontologies et graphiques de connaissances (p. ex., RDF/SPARQL, vocabulaire biomédical/chimique).

• Mise en oeuvre des données FAIR, gestion des métadonnées et outils de lignage

• Autoriser l'IA/ML et les cas d'utilisation analytique sur les données scientifiques

• Exposition de domaine en chimie, biologie, nourriture ou omique

• Les outils de rapport (p. ex. DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) constituent un avantage

• Exploiter l'IA Agentic pour automatiser les activités d'ingénierie des données

• Compétences non techniques requises

• Forte résolution de problèmes et état d'esprit pratique

• Excellentes compétences en communication et gestion des parties prenantes

• Expérience de collaboration avec des fournisseurs externes et des professionnels des données et conduite de livraison par d'autres

• Capacité de travailler en équipes interfonctionnelles et internationales

• Compétences solides en matière d ' organisation et de hiérarchisation

• Langue parlée et écrite Eng

jobs.title: Lead Patent Counsel - Digital & AI
jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland, with regular travel to Orbe and other Nestlé R&D sites
Work model: Full-time, 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent
Closing Date for Applications: 15th September 2026

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As a Patent Counsel in Digital & AI, your mission is to enable and protect Nestlé’s digital, AI-driven and electronics-centric innovations through pragmatic legal services and business-driven IP protection. You will act as the go-to Legal R&D partner for Digital & AI topics across the Nestlé R&D ecosystem, collaborating closely with R&D teams, Patent Counsels, R&D Counsels and IP Analysts. This is your opportunity to shape and grow the IP strategy for one of Nestlé’s most strategic innovation frontiers.

How you’ll make an impact as a Patent Counsel – Digital & AI

• Develop and deliver the IP strategy for digital, AI and electronics-driven innovations, in close partnership with R&D teams, the patent team, R&D Counsels and IP Analysts.

• Lead business-driven patent filing and prosecution, Freedom-to-Operate assessments, oppositions of third-party patents and defense against third-party oppositions.

• Manage your patent portfolio with strong business alignment and rigorous cost management.

• Advise on IP matters in R&D collaborations, including Digital & AI partnerships, licensing and joint developments.

• Support Coffee & Systems and other categories on connected systems, digital platforms and AI-based innovations, in collaboration with category Patent Counsels.

• Partner with Nestlé Research, the Nestlé Deep Tech Center, NPTC – Nestlé Professional and other R&D centers to protect digital and AI innovations across categories.

• Promote passion for IP through awareness sessions, training and communication, while contributing to the awareness and enforcement of Nestlé patents in R&D and in the markets.

What will make you successful

• Fully qualified patent attorney, European Patent Attorney (EQE) and/or national qualification in a major jurisdiction such as the USA, with a background in Electronics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI or a related engineering discipline.

• Proven experience in digital, AI and/or electronics-related IP projects, ideally including software-implemented inventions, AI/ML, connected devices and computer-implemented business methods.

• More than 3 years of post-qualification experience with patent drafting, prosecution and Freedom-to-Operate assessments in the digital, electronics or AI space.

• Experience developing business-driven IP strategies across multiple jurisdictions, with a solid understanding of software and AI patenting specificities such as EPO, USPTO and CNIPA.

• Service-oriented, pragmatic, rigorous, hands-on and collaborative, with the ability to engage confidently with R&D partners, category teams and stakeholders at different levels of seniority.

• Fluent in English; French is a plus.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Exciting opportunities to develop your career your way, across different brands, businesses, functions, and regions.

• Flexible working arrangements that facilitate creativity and collaboration.

• A culture of respect, with diversity, equity, and inclusion at its core.

• A dynamic international environment empowering you to learn, develop, and grow.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes

titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur de projet / Gestionnaire de projet Construction

jobs.description:
Standort: Basel, Schweiz
Arbeitsmodell: Vollzeit, vor Ort, in geringem Umfang kann Home Office möglich sein

Vertragsart / Dauer: Unbefriestet

Startdatum: Per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

Als Projektingenieur / Projektleiter Bau bei der Nestlé Suisse besteht Ihre Mission darin, die Planung, Koordination und Realisierung von Bauprojekten unterschiedlicher Komplexität für unsere THOMY Fabrik in Basel sicherzustellen. Das Aufgabenspektrum reicht von kleineren Unterhalts- und Sanierungsmassnahmen bis hin zu Neu- und Umbauprojekten. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit internen Kunden, Behörden, Planern, Architekten, Ingenieuren und Unternehmern zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ihre Expertise weiterzuentwickeln und die Zukunft unseres Produktionsstandorts aktiv mitzugestalten.

So werden Sie als Projektingenieur / Projektleiter Bau einen Unterschied machen

• Selbstständige Leitung und Begleitung von Bauprojekten von der Bedürfnisdefinition bis zur Inbetriebnahme.

• Planung, Ausschreibung, Vergabe und Überwachung von Bau- und Unterhaltsmassnahmen sowie Erstellung von Projekt-, Kosten- und Terminplänen und Sicherstellung deren Einhaltung.

• Führung und Koordination von externen Planern, Architekten, Ingenieuren und Unternehmern.

• Durchführung von Zustandsanalysen und Erarbeitung von Sanierungs- und Instandhaltungskonzepten sowie Organisation und Begleitung von Umbauten, Renovationen und kleineren Neubauprojekten.

• Überwachung der Bauausführung, Durchführung von Baustellenbegehungen sowie Kontrolle von Offerten, Rechnungen und Nachträgen.

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher sowie Nestlé-interner Vorschriften zur Arbeitssicherheit, interner Vorgaben, Qualitätsstandards und Compliance-Richtlinien für den Bereich Bau sowie Ansprechperson für interne Kunden, Behörden, Planer und Unternehmer.

Das macht Sie erfolgreich

• Hintergrund als Bauingenieur, Architekt, Techniker Bauplanung/Bauführung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation mit Erfahrung in der Projektleitung und Bauausführung.

• Erfahrung in der Planung, Koordination und Realisierung von Bau- und Umbauprojekten.

• Kenntnisse in Bauleitung, Ausschreibungen und Vergabeverfahren sowie ein gutes Verständnis für bautechnische, wirtschaftliche und organisatorische Zusammenhänge.

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Behörden, Planern und Unternehmern sowie eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise in enger Abstimmung mit den anderen Abteilungen der Fabrik.

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Organisations- und Durchsetzungsfähigkeiten sowie sicherer Umgang mit MS Office; Kenntnisse von CAD- oder Projektmanagement-Tools sind von Vorteil.

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• Mut, Teamorientierung, Agilität und kontinuierliche Lernbereitschaft.

Bei Nestlé stehen Menschen im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns

Unsere Benefits sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Ihr Wohlbefinden zu fördern, damit Sie sowohl beruflich als auch privat erfolgreich sein können:

• Zusätzliche Ferientage über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Beitrag an Gesundheitsleistungen sowie Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program für Sie und Ihre Familie

• Attraktive Arbeitgeberbeiträge an die Pensionskasse

• Leistungsorientierter Bonus

• Grosszügige Elternzeit und umfassende Familienunterstützung

• Vielfältige Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zur Weiterentwicklung Ihrer Fähigkeiten

• Mitarbeiterrabatte auf verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Rekrutierungsprozess erwarten können

Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven und respektvollen Rekrutierungsprozess ein und stellen bei Bedarf gerne angemessene Unterstützungsmassnahmen zur Verfügung. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zu

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: A tempo pieno, in loco, su piccola scala, ufficio domestico può essere possibile

Tipo di contratto / durata: Unfriended

Data di inizio: immediata o di accordo

Essere una forza per un cambiamento buono e accelerato che migliora la vita e il pianeta

Come Project Engineer / Project Manager Construction di Nestlé Suisse, la vostra missione è quella di garantire la progettazione, il coordinamento e la realizzazione di progetti di costruzione di varia complessità per la nostra THOMY factory di Basilea. La gamma di compiti spazia da misure di manutenzione e ristrutturazione più piccole a nuovi e progetti di conversione. Si farà la differenza lavorando a stretto contatto con clienti interni, autorità, pianificatori, architetti, ingegneri e imprenditori. Questa è la vostra opportunità di assumersi la responsabilità, sviluppare le vostre competenze e modellare attivamente il futuro del nostro sito di produzione.

Questo è come voi come ingegnere di progetto / project manager costruzione farà la differenza

• Gestione indipendente e supporto di progetti di costruzione dalla definizione di necessità alla messa in servizio.

• Pianificazione, appalto, assegnazione e monitoraggio delle misure di costruzione e manutenzione, nonché la stesura di progetti, costi e programmi e la loro conformità.

• Leadership e coordinamento di progettisti esterni, architetti, ingegneri e imprenditori.

• Attuazione di analisi delle condizioni e sviluppo di concetti di ristrutturazione e manutenzione, nonché organizzazione e supporto di conversioni, ristrutturazioni e piccoli nuovi progetti di costruzione.

• Supervisione di costruzione, visite di cantiere e controllo di offerte, fatture e integratori.

• Assicurare il rispetto delle normative legali e Nestlé-internal in materia di sicurezza sul lavoro, requisiti interni, standard di qualità e linee guida di conformità per il settore delle costruzioni, nonché persona di contatto per clienti interni, autorità, pianificatori e imprenditori.

Questo li rende di successo.

• Sfondo come ingegnere civile, architetto, tecnico di pianificazione delle costruzioni / gestione delle costruzioni o qualificazione paragonabile con esperienza nella gestione dei progetti e l'esecuzione delle costruzioni.

• Esperienza nella progettazione, coordinamento e realizzazione di progetti di costruzione e conversione.

• Conoscenza delle procedure di gestione delle costruzioni, di appalto e di appalto nonché una buona comprensione delle connessioni strutturali, economiche e organizzative.

• Esperienza nel trattare con autorità, pianificatori e imprenditori, nonché un metodo di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione in stretto coordinamento con gli altri dipartimenti della fabbrica.

• Forte comunicazione, capacità organizzative e di esecuzione e uso sicuro di MS Office; La conoscenza di CAD o strumenti di gestione di progetto è un vantaggio.

• Conoscenza molto buona del tedesco nella parola e nella scrittura; La conoscenza dell'inglese è un vantaggio.

• Coraggio, orientamento di squadra, agilità e disponibilità continua ad imparare.

A Nestlé, le persone sono al centro delle nostre azioni

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per promuovere la vostra crescita e il benessere in modo da poter avere successo sia professionalmente che privatamente:

• Giorni festivi aggiuntivi oltre i requisiti legali

• Contribuisci servizi sanitari e l'accesso al Programma di Assistenza per i Dipendenti per te e la tua famiglia

• Contributo del datore di lavoro attraente al fondo pensione

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Generoso congedo parentale e supporto familiare completo

• Diverse opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per sviluppare ulteriormente le tue competenze

• Sconti dei dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa ci si può aspettare dal nostro processo di reclutamento

Siamo impegnati in un processo di reclutamento inclusivo e rispettoso e siamo lieti di fornire adeguate misure di sostegno, se necessario. I nostri lavori sono completamente finiti
descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Basel, Switzerland
Work model: Full-time, on-site, on a small scale, home office may be possible

Contract type / duration: Unfriended

Start date: By immediate or by agreement

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Project Engineer / Project Manager Construction at Nestlé Suisse, your mission is to ensure the planning, coordination and realization of construction projects of varying complexity for our THOMY factory in Basel. The range of tasks ranges from smaller maintenance and renovation measures to new and conversion projects. You will make a difference by working closely with internal clients, authorities, planners, architects, engineers and entrepreneurs. This is your opportunity to take on responsibility, develop your expertise and actively shape the future of our production site.

This is how you as a project engineer / project manager construction will make a difference

• Independent management and support of construction projects from need definition to commissioning.

• Planning, tendering, awarding and monitoring of construction and maintenance measures as well as drawing up project, cost and schedules and ensuring compliance with them.

• Leadership and coordination of external planners, architects, engineers and entrepreneurs.

• Implementation of condition analyses and development of renovation and maintenance concepts as well as organization and support of conversions, renovations and smaller new construction projects.

• Supervision of construction, construction site visits and control of offers, invoices and supplements.

• Ensure compliance with legal and Nestlé-internal regulations on occupational safety, internal requirements, quality standards and compliance guidelines for the construction sector as well as contact person for internal customers, authorities, planners and entrepreneurs.

This makes them successful.

• Background as a civil engineer, architect, technician of construction planning / construction management or comparable qualification with experience in project management and construction execution.

• Experience in the planning, coordination and realization of construction and conversion projects.

• Knowledge of construction management, tendering and procurement procedures as well as a good understanding of structural, economic and organisational connections.

• Experience in dealing with authorities, planners and entrepreneurs as well as an independent, structured and solution-oriented working method in close coordination with the other departments of the factory.

• Strong communication, organizational and enforcement capabilities and secure use of MS Office; Knowledge of CAD or project management tools is an advantage.

• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing; Knowledge of English is an advantage.

• Courage, team orientation, agility and continuous willingness to learn.

At Nestlé, people are at the heart of our actions

Our benefits are designed to promote your growth and well-being so that you can succeed both professionally and privately:

• Additional holiday days beyond the legal requirements

• Contribute health services and access to the Employee Assistance Program for you and your family

• Attractive employer contributions to the pension fund

• Performance based bonus

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support

• Diverse learning and development opportunities to further develop your skills

• Employee discounts on various products and services

What you can expect from our recruitment process

jobs.description:
Location: Henniez, Switzerland

Work model: Office-based with hybrid flexibility / Full-time

Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

As the Head of Corporate Affairs and Sustainability at Nestlé Waters, you will lead Corporate Affairs and Sustainability to protect and proactively strengthen the reputation of Nestlé Waters and its brands in Switzerland. As a member of the Senior Leadership Team, you will drive strategic communications, stakeholder engagement, advocacy, sustainability initiatives, and issues & crisis management, while building trust with employees, local communities, media, authorities, NGOs, industry associations and other key stakeholders. You will work closely with the local leadership team and the global Corporate Affairs & Sustainability function to support the business strategy and sustainability commitments. This is your opportunity to unlock the future of beverages and craft experiences that elevate everyday living.

How you’ll make an impact as a Head of Corporate Affairs and Sustainability

• Leading the Corporate Affairs and Sustainability agenda for Nestlé Waters Suisse, shaping strategy, protecting reputation and strengthening trust among employees, communities, media and external stakeholders
.

• Developing and executing integrated communication, stakeholder engagement and advocacy plans aligned with business priorities, sustainability commitments and global corporate affairs strategy.

• Building strong relationships with media, authorities, industry associations, NGOs and local communities while acting as a trusted spokesperson and advisor to senior leadership.

• Driving impactful storytelling, executive communications, employee engagement initiatives and corporate events that increase awareness, alignment and advocacy across internal and external audiences.

• Leading issues and crisis preparedness and communication, ensuring effective governance, stakeholder alignment and timely responses that protect business reputation.

• Championing the sustainability strategy and roadmap, including water regeneration, climate action, circular packaging and community initiatives, while managing performance, budgets and delivery against key commitments.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in corporate affairs, communications, public relations and reputation management, with the ability to develop and implement impactful strategies and plans.

• Applying strong business acumen, strategic thinking and project leadership skills to translate priorities into measurable communication and sustainability outcomes.

• Bringing know-how and expertise in sustainability topics, as well as project management skills and team coordination competencies.

• Using advanced stakeholder engagement, advocacy and influencing skills to build partnerships and drive alignment across a complex matrix environment.

• Managing multiple priorities, budgets and cross-functional initiatives while delivering high-quality results with agility and accountability.

• Bringing a strong network in Swiss media relation and/or Food & Beverage Industry.

• Communicating fluently in French, German (including Swiss German) and English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé Waters, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

Essere una forza per il cambiamento buono e accelera che migliora la vita e il pianeta.

In qualità di Responsabile Affari e Sostenibilità presso Nestlé Waters, guiderai gli Affari Aziendali e la Sostenibilità a proteggere e rafforzare proattivamente la reputazione di Nestlé Waters e dei suoi marchi in Svizzera. Come membro del Senior Leadership Team, guiderete le comunicazioni strategiche, l'impegno degli stakeholder, l'advocacy, le iniziative di sostenibilità e la gestione delle questioni e delle crisi, mentre costruite la fiducia con i dipendenti, le comunità locali, i media, le autorità, le ONG, le associazioni del settore e altri stakeholder chiave. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il team di leadership locale e la funzione globale Corporate Affairs & Sustainability per supportare la strategia aziendale e gli impegni di sostenibilità. Questa è la vostra occasione per sbloccare il futuro delle bevande e delle esperienze artigianali che elevano la vita quotidiana.

Come farete un impatto come responsabile degli affari aziendali e della sostenibilità

• Guidare l'agenda Corporate Affairs and Sustainability per Nestlé Waters Suisse, modellare la strategia, proteggere la reputazione e rafforzare la fiducia tra dipendenti, comunità, media e stakeholder esterni
.

• Lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione di piani di comunicazione integrati, impegno e advocacy degli stakeholder sono allineati alle priorità aziendali, agli impegni di sostenibilità e alla strategia aziendale globale.

• Costruire forti relazioni con i media, le autorità, le associazioni del settore, le ONG e le comunità locali, agendo come portavoce di fiducia e consulente per la leadership senior.

• Guidare lo storytelling impatto, le comunicazioni esecutive, le iniziative di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti e gli eventi aziendali che aumentano la consapevolezza, l'allineamento e l'advocacy attraverso il pubblico interno ed esterno.

• Problemi principali e preparazione della crisi e della comunicazione, garantendo una governance efficace, allineamento delle parti interessate e risposte tempestive che proteggono la reputazione aziendale.

• Sfruttando la strategia di sostenibilità e la roadmap, tra cui la rigenerazione dell'acqua, l'azione climatica, l'imballaggio circolare e le iniziative comunitarie, gestendo performance, budget e consegna contro gli impegni chiave.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare una forte esperienza in affari aziendali, comunicazioni, pubbliche relazioni e gestione della reputazione, con la capacità di sviluppare e implementare strategie e piani di impatto.

• Applicando acume aziendale forte, pensiero strategico e capacità di leadership di progetto per tradurre le priorità in risultati di comunicazione e sostenibilità misurabili.

• Portare know-how e competenze in materia di sostenibilità, oltre a competenze di gestione del progetto e competenze di coordinamento del team.

• Utilizzando l'impegno avanzato delle parti interessate, la promozione e l'influenza delle competenze per costruire partnership e guidare l'allineamento in un ambiente di matrice complesso.

• Gestione di più priorità, budget e iniziative interfunzionali, offrendo risultati di alta qualità con agilità e responsabilità.

• Portare una forte rete in relazione ai media svizzeri e/o Food & Beverage Industry.

• Comunicare fluentemente in francese, tedesco (tra cui tedesco svizzero) e inglese.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

A Nestlé Waters, mettiamo le persone nel cuore di tutto ciò che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Leitung der Corporate Affairs und Nachhaltigkeitsagenda von Nestlé Waters Suisse, Gestaltung der Strategie, Schutz der Reputation und Stärkung des Vertrauens zwischen Mitarbeitern, Gemeinschaften, Medien und externen Stakeholdern
.

• Aufbau starker Beziehungen zu Medien, Behörden, Branchenverbänden, NGOs und lokalen Gemeinschaften, während er als vertrauenswürdiger Sprecher und Berater der Führungsebene fungiert.

• Förderung von wirkungsvollem Storytelling, Executive Communications, Initiativen zur Mitarbeiterbindung und Unternehmensveranstaltungen, die das Bewusstsein, die Ausrichtung und die Interessenvertretung bei internen und externen Zielgruppen erhöhen.

• Führende Themen und Krisenvorsorge und Kommunikation, Gewährleistung einer effektiven Governance, Ausrichtung der Stakeholder und rechtzeitige Reaktionen, die die Reputation von Unternehmen schützen.

• Verfechtung der Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie und des Fahrplans, einschließlich Wasserregeneration, Klimaschutz, Kreislaufverpackung und Gemeinschaftsinitiativen, während die Leistung, die Budgets und die Lieferung im Rahmen der wichtigsten Verpflichtungen verwaltet werden.

• Bringen Sie starke Expertise in Corporate Affairs, Kommunikation, Öffentlichkeitsarbeit und Reputationsmanagement mit der Fähigkeit, wirkungsvolle Strategien und Pläne zu entwickeln und umzusetzen.

• Anwendung von starkem Geschäftssinn, strategischem Denken und Projektführungskompetenzen, um Prioritäten in messbare Kommunikations- und Nachhaltigkeitsergebnisse umzusetzen.

• Mithilfe von fortschrittlichem Stakeholder-Engagement, Advocacy und beeinflussenden Fähigkeiten, um Partnerschaften aufzubauen und die Ausrichtung in einer komplexen Matrixumgebung voranzutreiben.

.

Be a force for good and feel trusted to make decisions that matter.

As a Global Procurement Manager for Machines at Nestlé Global Procurement, your mission is to lead and implement the global sourcing strategy for Nespresso Original Line and Milk frother, delivering value through innovation, competitiveness, sustainability, and risk management. You are responsible for end-to-end spend management, supplier selection, negotiations and managing relationships with coffee machine manufacturers to ensure a reliable, high-quality, and cost-effective supply chain aligned with Nestlé’s Procurement Standards. We operate on a truly global scale, bringing together over 40 nationalities across three dynamic hubs in Switzerland, Panama, and Malaysia. This is your chance to drive innovation, sustainability, and impact at scale, ensuring value creation through responsibly sourced supply across diverse categories.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global Procurement Manager – Machines

• Define and implement the sourcing strategy for Nespresso Original Line and Milk frother, aligned with the Global Beverage Machine category while contributing to its development.

• Lead sourcing activities for supplier selection, leveraging negotiations, eRFX solutions, and by executing best‑in‑class Manufacturing and Supply Agreements.

• Build and lead the efficiency roadmap by driving cost‑reduction initiatives such as component standardization through platform approaches, best‑cost‑country sourcing and the use of alternative materials.

• Strengthen sourcing flexibility and supply risk mitigation across the full value chain, from Machine assembly to components and their raw materials.

• Build strong relationships with Nespresso Procurement business partners to unlock full category‑management value.

• Lead supplier development and compliance, including performance assessment and supplier profiling with clear targets and development plans.

• Develop and analyze TDC (Total Delivered Cost), monitor commodity trends and manage budget variations through proactive price anticipation and productivity impact.

What will make you successful

• Solid experience and proven proficiency in procurement within above‑market or large‑market structures, ideally in Contract Manufacturing procurement or technical categories.

• Dual competence supported by a degree in mechanical or electronic engineering (preferred).

• Advanced negotiation capabilities, with proven experience in eRFX and high‑value contract management.

• Strong analytical skills and Total Delivered Cost mindset, with the ability to manage multiple sub‑categories simultaneously (electronics, electro‑mechanical, plastic injection, CAPEX).

• Excellent communication abilities, enabling clear presentation of opportunities, results, and actionable recommendations.

• Fluent written and spoken English, any additional language considered as a strong plus.

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As an IP Paralegal at Nestlé, your mission is to support Senior Legal Counsels responsible for trademark portfolios and to independently drive intellectual property projects. To support one of our newly integrated Strategic Business Unit, you will play a key role in ensuring strong portfolio management, efficient ways of working and close collaboration with internal business and legal stakeholders. You will make a difference by helping protect and strengthen Nestlé’s brands through accurate trademark searches, portfolio management and legal research.

How you’ll make an impact as an IP Paralegal

• Conducting trademark availability searches, analysing results and making clear recommendations to the responsible Counsel(s).

• Managing trademark and industrial design registration processes from filing to grant for specific Business Unit(s), aligned with business roll-out plans.

• Handling objections from IP Authorities, defensive oppositions and related agreements, undertakings and co-existence terms.

• Monitoring competitive trademark publications, supporting oppositions where needed and drafting reports on moderately complex legal matters.

• Keeping internal records accurate by creating and updating files, docketing deadlines and monitoring key portfolio milestones.

• Supporting legal research, evidence gathering and litigation activities by organising information, sales figures and marketing materials for trademark and design matters.

What will make you successful

• Bringing solid experience in trademarks within an international environment or a law firm.

• Working confidently with online databases and web-based IP management systems, ideally Memotech, or showing strong digital agility to onboard quickly.

• Combining excellent planning and organisational skills with strong accuracy and attention to detail.

• Being flexible, proactive and collaborative, with the curiosity and agility to work autonomously and take initiative.

• Being curious about innovation and comfortable working with digital tools, data analytics and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions, to help drive operational excellence and support the future development of our IP services.

• Communicating fluently in written and spoken English; good spoken French is desirable.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

• Exciting opportunities to develop your career your way across different brands, businesses, functions and regions.

• A dynamic international environment empowering you to learn, develop and grow.

In qualità di IP Paralegal a Nestlé, la vostra missione è quella di supportare gli avvocati senior responsabili dei portafogli di marchi e di guidare in modo indipendente progetti di proprietà intellettuale. Per supportare una delle nostre nuove unità strategiche di business integrate, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel garantire una forte gestione del portafoglio, modi efficienti di lavorare e una stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni e legali. Farete la differenza aiutando a proteggere e rafforzare i marchi di Nestlé attraverso accurate ricerche di marchi, gestione del portafoglio e ricerca legale.

Come farete un impatto come un IP Paralegal

• Condurre le ricerche di disponibilità del marchio, analizzare i risultati e formulare raccomandazioni chiare al Consiglio(i) responsabile.

• Gestire i processi di registrazione del marchio e del design industriale dal deposito alla concessione di specifiche unità aziendali, allineati con i piani di roll-out aziendali.

• Gestione delle obiezioni da parte delle autorità IP, delle opposizioni difensive e dei relativi accordi, delle imprese e dei termini di coesistenza.

• Monitoraggio delle pubblicazioni dei marchi concorrenziali, sostegno alle opposizioni ove necessario e redazione di rapporti su questioni giuridiche moderatamente complesse.

• Mantenere i record interni accurati creando e aggiornando i file, le scadenze di docking e il monitoraggio delle tappe chiave del portafoglio.

• Sostenere le attività legali di ricerca, raccolta di prove e contenzioso organizzando informazioni, cifre di vendita e materiali di marketing per le questioni di marchi e design.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare solida esperienza nei marchi all'interno di un ambiente internazionale o uno studio legale.

• Lavorare con fiducia con database online e sistemi di gestione IP basati sul web, idealmente Memotech, o mostrare una forte agilità digitale a bordo rapidamente.

• Combinando eccellenti capacità di pianificazione e organizzazione con una forte precisione e attenzione ai dettagli.

• Essendo flessibile, proattivo e collaborativo, con la curiosità e l'agilità di lavorare autonomamente e prendere iniziativa.

• Essere curiosi dell'innovazione e del lavoro confortevole con strumenti digitali, analisi dei dati e tecnologie emergenti, comprese le soluzioni AI-enabled, per aiutare a guidare l'eccellenza operativa e sostenere lo sviluppo futuro dei nostri servizi IP.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese scritto e parlato; buon francese parlato è auspicabile.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

A Société des Produits Nestlé S.A., mettiamo le persone nel cuore di tutto quello che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Eccitanti opportunità per sviluppare la tua carriera attraverso diversi marchi, aziende, funzioni e regioni.

• Disposizioni di lavoro flessibili che facilitano la creatività e la collaborazione.

• Una cultura del rispetto, con diversità, equità e inclusione al suo centro.

• Un ambiente dinamico internazionale che ti consente di imparare, sviluppare e crescere.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Il reclutamento sarà guidato dalla misura tra le singole competenze e i requisiti del ruolo. Ogni candidato le cui competenze corrispondono alle esigenze del lavoro saranno considerate. Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario.

Se avete bisogno di un adattamento durante il processo di reclutamento, fatecelo sapere in modo da potervi sostenere efficacemente. Tutte le informazioni saranno trattate con riservatezza.

Il processo di assunzione include tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le applicazioni come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta

Um eine unserer neu integrierten strategischen Geschäftseinheiten zu unterstützen, spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gewährleistung eines starken Portfoliomanagements, effizienter Arbeitsweisen und einer engen Zusammenarbeit mit internen Geschäfts- und Rechtsakteuren. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie die Marken von Nestlé durch genaue Markenrecherchen, Portfoliomanagement und rechtliche Forschung schützen und stärken.

Wie Sie als IP Paralegal etwas bewirken können

• Durchführung von Markenverfügbarkeitssuchen, Analyse der Ergebnisse und klare Empfehlungen an die zuständigen Berater.

• Verwalten von Marken- und Industriedesign-Registrierungsprozessen von der Einreichung bis zur Erteilung für bestimmte Business Units, abgestimmt auf Business-Rollout-Pläne.

• Umgang mit Einwänden von IP-Behörden, defensiven Einsprüchen und damit verbundenen Vereinbarungen, Verpflichtungen und Koexistenzbedingungen.

• Überwachung wettbewerbsfähiger Markenveröffentlichungen, Unterstützung von Einsprüchen bei Bedarf und Erstellung von Berichten über mäßig komplexe Rechtsfragen.

• Richtige interne Aufzeichnungen durch Erstellen und Aktualisieren von Dateien, Andocken von Fristen und Überwachung der wichtigsten Meilensteine des Portfolios.

• Unterstützung der juristischen Forschung, der Sammlung von Beweisen und Rechtsstreitigkeiten durch Organisation von Informationen, Verkaufszahlen und Marketingmaterialien für Marken- und Designangelegenheiten.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Mitbringen von solider Erfahrung in Marken innerhalb eines internationalen Umfelds oder einer Anwaltskanzlei.

• Sicheres Arbeiten mit Online-Datenbanken und webbasierten IP-Managementsystemen, idealerweise Memotech, oder eine starke digitale Agilität für schnelles Onboard.

• Kombinieren Sie exzellente Planungs- und Organisationsfähigkeiten mit hoher Genauigkeit und Liebe zum Detail.

• Flexibel, proaktiv und kooperativ sein, mit der Neugier und Agilität, autonom zu arbeiten und Initiative zu ergreifen.

• Neugierig auf Innovation und komfortables Arbeiten mit digitalen Tools, Datenanalysen und neuen Technologien, einschließlich KI-fähiger Lösungen, um die operative Exzellenz voranzutreiben und die zukünftige Entwicklung unserer IP-Dienste zu unterstützen.

• Fließend in geschriebenem und gesprochenem Englisch kommunizieren; gut gesprochenes Französisch ist wünschenswert.

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen.

Bei Société des Produits Nestlé S.A. stellen wir den Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Spannende Möglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere in verschiedenen Marken, Unternehmen, Funktionen und Regionen zu entwickeln.

• Flexible Arbeitsvereinbarungen, die Kreativität und Zusammenarbeit erleichtern.

• Eine Kultur des Respekts, mit Vielfalt, Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion im Mittelpunkt.

• Ein dynamisches internationales Umfeld, in dem Sie lernen, sich entwickeln und wachsen können.

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können
